<user_query>
Search C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Archives\NeuralShell_release_master_proof and C:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell for any installed UI proof scripts, release proof scripts, or validation-artifacts related to package proof / installed UI proof (2135, 2136, release-master). Return: file paths, brief description of what each script does, and any key test IDs/selectors used for the 27 installed UI checks.
</user_query>

Searching both directories for proof scripts, validation artifacts, and references to 2135/2136/release-master.

[REDACTED]

## Summary

**`C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Archives\NeuralShell_release_master_proof`** is the release-master worktree (v2.1.35) and holds the **2135 / 2136 / release-master proof lane** under `validation-artifacts/` (gitignored but present on disk).

**`C:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell`** is an older checkout (v2.1.33) and **does not contain** those validation-artifact scripts; it only has `.gitignore` / `package.json` exclusions for `validation-artifacts/`.

The canonical **27-check** suite is **`post-ocl-master-checkpoint-smoke.js`** (dev Electron launch). The **installed / packaged UI proof** for v2.1.35 is **`installed-ui-smoke.js`** with **29 checks** (27 + `exe-present` + `version-2135-visible`). Release notes referenced **29/29**, not 27/27.

---

## Archives only — validation-artifacts (2135 / 2136 / release-master)

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Archives\NeuralShell_release_master_proof\validation-artifacts\post-release\phase-post-ocl-master-checkpoint\post-ocl-master-checkpoint-smoke.js` | **27/27 runtime smoke** on master `9c13f27` (launches repo via `electron.launch({ args: ['.'] })`). |
| `...\phase-post-ocl-master-checkpoint\ELECTRON-SMOKE.md` | Human summary of 27 checks. |
| `...\phase-post-ocl-master-checkpoint\runtime-smoke-report.json` | JSON report artifact. |
| `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Archives\NeuralShell_release_master_proof\validation-artifacts\release-master-9c13f27-2135-package-proof\installed-ui-smoke.js` | **29/29 installed UI proof** against `dist/win-unpacked/NeuralShell.exe` (packaged, not NSIS-installed path). |
| `...\installed-ui-smoke-report.json` | JSON report (all pass on 2026-05-20). |
| `...\PACKAGE-PROOF.md` | Package proof write-up (installer hash, build shape). |
| `...\RELEASE-DECISION.md` | Release decision notes. |
| `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Archives\NeuralShell_release_master_proof\validation-artifacts\release-master-dab64f5-2135-release\RELEASE-COMPLETE.md` | Post-tag release completion record. |
| `...\RELEASE-NOTES-2.1.35.md` | Release notes. |
| `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Archives\NeuralShell_release_master_proof\validation-artifacts\post-release\phase-2136-polish-implementation\runtime-smoke-2136.js` | **2136** polish regression smoke (dev launch; 7 named `run()` blocks). |
| `...\PROOF-SUMMARY.md` | Phase 2136 proof summary. |
| `...\runtime-smoke-report.json` | 2136 smoke JSON. |

Related post-release smokes in the same tree (OCL/ALE lanes, not 2135):  
`validation-artifacts/post-release/phase-ocl-a-panel-bus-migration/ocl-a-runtime-smoke.js`,  
`phase-ocl-b-mount-operations-core-layer/ocl-b-runtime-smoke.js`,  
`phase-p2-lazy-b*/b*-runtime-smoke.js`, etc.

---

## Temp / ad-hoc (not in either repo) — UAT 2135

Created during a prior agent session for **NSIS-installed** v2.1.35 at `%LOCALAPPDATA%\NeuralShell-uat-2135\`:

| Path | Checks | Notes |
|------|--------|-------|
| `C:\Users\KickA\AppData\Local\Temp\neuralshell-uat-2135\uat-audit-2135.js` | **16** `runCheck` | Uses `Execute Command`; ~16 UI probes. |
| `...\uat-audit-2135-v2.js` | **18** `runCheck` | Uses Enter-to-send; split slash checks. |

These are **not** the canonical 27/29 lane scripts.

---

## Both trees — committed release / UI proof scripts

Present in **Archives** and **GitHub** (same or near-same paths):

| Path | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| `scripts\ui_self_sell_proof.cjs` | Playwright Electron: proof/ROI/lock flow; `--packaged` → `release/ui-self-sell-proof-report-packaged.json`. |
| `scripts\ui_persistence_proof.cjs` | Session persistence + chat row proof (separate sales/persistence lane). |
| `scripts\compare_self_sell_proof_reports.cjs` | Runtime vs packaged self-sell parity → `release/ui-self-sell-proof-parity.json`. |
| `scripts\release_health_check.cjs` | Requires packaged self-sell + parity JSON. |
| `scripts\package-product-release.ps1` | Build/stage product ZIP; copies `docs/proofs/verify-ui-self-hosted-windows-*.md` if present. |
| `scripts\verify-ui-serial-worker.ps1` | CI wrapper for Playwright `verify:ui` / offline-kill modes. |
| `scripts\postinstall_validation_check.cjs` | Post-install file checks incl. `release/release-gate.json`. |
| `scripts\release-upgrade-validation.js` | Strict upgrade validation vs `release-gate.json`. |
| `tear\release-gate.js` | Full release gate: artifacts, packaged smoke, installer smoke, benchmark. |
| `tear\smoke-packaged.js` | Launches `NeuralShell.exe --smoke-mode`; validates `release/packaged-smoke-report.json`. |
| `tear\smoke-installer.js` | Strict NSIS install + installed-app smoke (`rendererLoad`, `rendererDom`, `ipcHandshake`). |
| `tear\smoke-packaged-governance.js` | Phase 25 trust-state matrix (7 scenarios + operator actions). |
| `tear\smoke-native-trust.js` | Packaged native trust scenarios. |
| `tear\smoke-installer-lifecycle.js` | Phase 29 installer lifecycle proof. |
| `tear\hotfix-2134-provider-proof.js` | **2134** static provider message proof (no UI). |
| `scripts\founder_beta_clean_machine_dry_run.cjs` | Founder-beta clean-machine UI dry run (overlaps self-sell selectors). |

**Archives-only extra in `npm test`:** `hotfix-2134-provider-proof.js` is in Archives `package.json` test chain; GitHub v2.1.33 `package.json` omits it.

---

## 27 installed UI checks — IDs and key selectors

Source: `post-ocl-master-checkpoint-smoke.js` (same core as `installed-ui-smoke.js` minus the two packaging checks).

| # | Check ID | Primary selectors / signals |
|---|----------|----------------------------|
| 1 | `app-boots` | `top-status-bar` visible |
| 2 | `top-bar-p1-chips` | Visible: `mission-control-open-btn`, `ecosystem-open-btn`, `task-manager-open-btn`, `adaptive-layout-open-btn` |
| 3 | `mission-via-ocl` | Click `mission-control-open-btn` → `mission-control` visible |
| 4 | `eco-via-ocl` | Click `ecosystem-open-btn` → `ecosystem-launcher` visible |
| 5 | `mission-eco-no-stack` | `mission-control` not visible when Eco open |
| 6 | `analytics-opens` | `more-menu-btn` → `analytics-open-btn` → `analytics-enable-btn` |
| 7 | `analytics-closes` | `analytics-enable-btn` hidden after Escape |
| 8 | `fleet-opens` | `/fleet` via `chat-input` + **Send** → text `Opening Fleet Control` → `fleet-control-panel` |
| 9 | `fleet-closes` | `fleet-control-panel` hidden after Escape |
| 10 | `recovery-opens` | `/recovery` → `Opening Recovery Center` → `recovery-center` |
| 11 | `recovery-closes` | `recovery-center` hidden after Escape |
| 12 | `tasks-app-owned` | `task-manager-open-btn` → `task-manager-drawer` → `task-manager-close-btn` |
| 13 | `watchdog-alerts-opens` | Mission open → `watchdog-status-badge` → `runtime-alerts-drawer` |
| 14 | `alerts-coexist-mission` | `mission-control` still visible with alerts drawer |
| 15 | `p0-projects` | `button[title="Projects (Ctrl+P)"]` → `recovery-panel-projects-mode` |
| 16 | `p0-agents` | `button[title="Agent Marketplace"]` → `recovery-panel-agent-store` |
| 17 | `p0-voice` | `button[title="Voice input"]` → `recovery-panel-voice-mode` (optional `voice-panel`) |
| 18 | `layout-ale-opens` | `adaptive-layout-open-btn` → `adaptive-layout-engine` |
| 19 | `ale-operator-preset` | Role button **Operator**; `localStorage` key `neuralshell_adaptive_layout_v1` contains `operator` |
| 20 | `exec-palette` | `command-palette-btn` → `command-palette` |
| 21 | `settings` | `Control+,` → `settings-drawer` |
| 22 | `help` | `/help` in `chat-input` → text `NeuralShell Operator Guide` |
| 23 | `freeform` | Freeform message in composer |
| 24 | `no-kernel-role-error` | No `[data-role="kernel"].text-rose-400` error nodes (installed script hardcodes pass) |
| 25 | `no-eacces-port-crash` | No EACCES in console |
| 26 | `no-fatal-console` | No fatal console lines (filtered list) |
| 27 | `no-page-errors` | No `pageerror` events |

**Installed UI proof adds two checks (29 total):**

| # | Check ID | Selectors |
|---|----------|-----------|
| 28 | `exe-present` | `dist/win-unpacked/NeuralShell.exe` exists |
| 29 | `version-2135-visible` | Text `v2.1.35` visible (via `getByText('v2.1.35')`) |

Overlay dismissal uses: `onboarding-close-btn`, `firstboot-close-btn`, Escape.

---

## GitHub `NeuralShell` vs Archives

| Item | Archives | GitHub |
|------|----------|--------|
| `validation-artifacts/**` | **121 files on disk** | **Absent** (gitignored) |
| `installed-ui-smoke.js` / 27-check checkpoint | Archives only | Not present |
| `ui_self_sell_proof.cjs`, `release-gate.js`, tear smokes | Yes (v2.1.35) | Yes (v2.1.33, fewer test deps) |
| Worktree link | Standalone archive | `.git` points at `NeuralShell/.git/worktrees/NeuralShell_release_master_proof` |

---

## 2135 / 2136 naming map

- **2135** → release package proof lane: folder `release-master-9c13f27-2135-package-proof`, UAT install dir `NeuralShell-uat-2135`, bump merge `dab64f5`.
- **2136** → post-release polish: `phase-2136-polish-implementation/runtime-smoke-2136.js`.
- **2134** → `tear/hotfix-2134-provider-proof.js` (provider IPC, not UI).
- **release-master** → Archives worktree + folders `release-master-9c13f27-2135-package-proof`, `release-master-dab64f5-2135-release`.

If you need the **29-check** installed script run against a **silent-installed** path (not `win-unpacked`), that was the temp `uat-audit-2135*.js` scripts under `%TEMP%\neuralshell-uat-2135\`, not the committed `installed-ui-smoke.js`.
